items.text: From these considerations, which are all of them unquestionable principles of truth, two things are evident.
That there was no way of the justification and salvation of sinners revealed and proposed from the foundation of the world, but only by Jesus Christ, as declared in the first promise.
That there was no way for the participation of the benefits of that promise, or of his work of mediation, but by faith in him as so promised.

samples.anchor: 2. This assumption was the only immediate act of the divine nature on the human in the person of the Son. All those that follow, in subsistence, sustentation, with all others that are communicative, do ensue thereon.

items.text: This assumption and the hypostatical union are distinct and different in the formal reason of them.
Assumption is the immediate act of the divine nature in the person of the Son on the human; union is mediate, by virtue of that assumption.
Assumption is unto personality; it is that act whereby the Son of God and our nature became one person. Union is an act or relation of the natures subsisting in that one person.
Assumption respects the acting of the divine and the passion of the human nature; the one assumeth, the other is assumed.
